summary: Iteration 10 — Apple 2.1(b) IAP review-screenshot verification + backend regression. 15/15 pytest PASS. (A) Paywall source (/app/frontend/app/paywall.tsx) confirmed to render prices purely from RevenueCat: annual.product.priceString (line 225), monthly.product.priceString (line 240), and CTA text `Continue — ${chosen.product.priceString}` (line 303). No hardcoded $ fallback anywhere in the file (regex-scan for priceString || '$...' returns no match). (B) All 4 IAP review screenshots exist at Apple's required resolutions: annual_6.7_1290x2796.png=1290x2796, monthly_6.7_1290x2796.png=1290x2796, annual_6.5_1242x2688.png=1242x2688, monthly_6.5_1242x2688.png=1242x2688; each file >100 KB. (C) OCR via tesseract 5.3.0 on each screenshot: annual screenshots contain `60` and DO NOT contain `79.99`; monthly screenshots contain `8.99` and DO NOT contain `9.99`. (D) README.md documents both product IDs (com.emergent.narcanalyzer.cslz18.pro.annual and .pro.monthly) with attachment instructions. (E) Backend regression pytest: /api/transcribe multipart 'file' PASS, /api/analyze mode=text PASS, /api/auth/apple invalid → 4xx PASS, /api/auth/session invalid → 4xx PASS, /api/history POST+GET scoped by X-Device-Id PASS. (F) Paywall smoke test at 390x844: paywall-close and paywall-purchase render; no raw error strings (PurchasesError/identity_not_ready/readable_error_code) in DOM. As explicitly instructed in the review request, the RC Test Store cache in browser preview still shows $79.99/$9.99 — this is intentionally NOT flagged as a bug per support_agent's guidance; real App Store prices come from ASC at deploy time and the source now reads them dynamically.
